{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print('Data shape:', df.shape)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for presence of control arm and moderate severity
print('\nArms present:', df['arm'].unique())
print('Severity levels:', df['severity'].unique())

# Check if responded is binary
print('\nResponded values and counts:')
print(df['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print('\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
